# HeyRanks

> HeyRanks sends small businesses a weekly, plain-English report on their Google SEO, their visibility in AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot) and their digital marketing, with the 5 most important things to fix each week. It costs ₹849 one-time for 180 days (26 weekly reports), with a ₹4,149 lifetime founder plan for the first 500 customers.

HeyRanks is a product of DexoSoft Solutions, based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. It suits local businesses (clinics, restaurants, salons, real estate, coaching), e-commerce brands, freelancers and marketing agencies.

## What each weekly report includes
- Technical SEO audit: speed, mobile, meta tags, sitemaps, indexing
- AI visibility: whether AI assistants mention the business for real customer questions
- Competitor watch (3 competitors, 5 on lifetime)
- Keyword, content and social media post ideas
- Google Business Profile and review reply suggestions
- Copy-paste fixes: Schema.org markup, llms.txt, meta tags
- Same-day alerts for downtime, SSL expiry and ranking drops (email and WhatsApp)

## Key facts
- Free scan available on the homepage
- No auto-renewal; 30-day money-back guarantee
- No technical skills needed
